verses.original: וַיַּ֣רְא בִּלְעָ֗ם כִּ֣י ט֞וֹב בְּעֵינֵ֤י יְהוָה֙ לְבָרֵ֣ךְ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְלֹא־ הָלַ֥ךְ כְּפַֽעַם־ בְּפַ֖עַם לִקְרַ֣את נְחָשִׁ֑ים וַיָּ֥שֶׁת אֶל־ הַמִּדְבָּ֖ר פָּנָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar bil·‘ām kî ṭō·wḇ bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh lə·ḇā·rêḵ ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl wə·lō- hā·laḵ kə·p̄a·‘am- bə·p̄a·‘am liq·raṯ nə·ḥā·šîm way·yā·šeṯ ’el- ham·miḏ·bār pā·nāw
verses.literal: And when Balaam saw that it pleased . . . the LORD to bless Israel he did not seek omens as on previous occasions . . . . . . but he turned his face toward the wilderness

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֨א בִלְעָ֜ם אֶת־ עֵינָ֗יו וַיַּרְא֙ אֶת־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שֹׁכֵ֖ן לִשְׁבָטָ֑יו וַתְּהִ֥י עָלָ֖יו ר֥וּחַ אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·śā ḇil·‘ām ’eṯ- ‘ê·nāw way·yar ’eṯ- yiś·rā·’êl šō·ḵên liš·ḇā·ṭāw wat·tə·hî ‘ā·lāw rū·aḥ ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: When Balaam looked up . . . and saw Israel encamped tribe by tribe the Spirit of God came upon him

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֥א מְשָׁל֖וֹ וַיֹּאמַ֑ר נְאֻ֤ם בִּלְעָם֙ בְּנ֣וֹ בְעֹ֔ר וּנְאֻ֥ם הַגֶּ֖בֶר שְׁתֻ֥ם הָעָֽיִן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·śā mə·šā·lōw way·yō·mar nə·’um bil·‘ām bə·nōw ḇə·‘ōr ū·nə·’um hag·ge·ḇer šə·ṯum hā·‘ā·yin
verses.literal: and he lifted up an oracle saying This is the prophecy of Balaam son of Beor the prophecy of a man whose eyes are open

verses.original: נְאֻ֕ם שֹׁמֵ֖עַ אִמְרֵי־ אֵ֑ל אֲשֶׁ֨ר מַחֲזֵ֤ה שַׁדַּי֙ יֶֽחֱזֶ֔ה נֹפֵ֖ל וּגְל֥וּי עֵינָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: nə·’um šō·mê·a‘ ’im·rê- ’êl ’ă·šer ma·ḥă·zêh šad·day ye·ḥĕ·zeh nō·p̄êl ū·ḡə·lui ‘ê·nā·yim
verses.literal: the prophecy of one who hears the words of God who sees a vision from the Almighty who bows down with eyes wide open

verses.original: מַה־ טֹּ֥בוּ אֹהָלֶ֖יךָ יַעֲקֹ֑ב מִשְׁכְּנֹתֶ֖יךָ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: mah- ṭō·ḇū ’ō·hā·le·ḵā ya·‘ă·qōḇ miš·kə·nō·ṯe·ḵā yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: How lovely are your tents O Jacob your dwellings O Israel

verses.original: כִּנְחָלִ֣ים נִטָּ֔יוּ כְּגַנֹּ֖ת עֲלֵ֣י נָהָ֑ר כַּאֲהָלִים֙ נָטַ֣ע יְהוָ֔ה כַּאֲרָזִ֖ים עֲלֵי־ מָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: kin·ḥā·lîm niṭ·ṭā·yū kə·ḡan·nōṯ ‘ă·lê nā·hār ka·’ă·hā·lîm nā·ṭa‘ Yah·weh ka·’ă·rā·zîm ‘ă·lê- mā·yim
verses.literal: They spread out like palm groves like gardens beside a stream like aloes the LORD has planted like cedars beside the waters

verses.original: יִֽזַּל־ מַ֙יִם֙ מִדָּ֣לְיָ֔ו וְזַרְע֖וֹ בְּמַ֣יִם רַבִּ֑ים וְיָרֹ֤ם מֵֽאֲגַג֙ מַלְכּ֔וֹ וְתִנַּשֵּׂ֖א מַלְכֻתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: yiz·zal- ma·yim mid·dā·lə·yāw wə·zar·‘ōw bə·ma·yim rab·bîm wə·yā·rōm mê·’ă·ḡaḡ mal·kōw wə·ṯin·naś·śê mal·ḵu·ṯōw
verses.literal: Water will flow from his buckets and his seed will have abundant water His king will be greater than Agag and his kingdom will be exalted

verses.original: אֵ֚ל מוֹצִיא֣וֹ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם כְּתוֹעֲפֹ֥ת רְאֵ֖ם ל֑וֹ יֹאכַ֞ל גּוֹיִ֣ם צָרָ֗יו וְעַצְמֹתֵיהֶ֛ם יְגָרֵ֖ם וְחִצָּ֥יו יִמְחָֽץ׃
verses.transliteration: ’êl mō·w·ṣî·’ōw mim·miṣ·ra·yim kə·ṯō·w·‘ă·p̄ōṯ rə·’êm lōw yō·ḵal gō·w·yim ṣā·rāw wə·‘aṣ·mō·ṯê·hem yə·ḡā·rêm wə·ḥiṣ·ṣāw yim·ḥāṣ
verses.literal: God brought him out of Egypt with strength like a wild ox to devour hostile nations and crush their bones to pierce them with arrows

verses.original: כָּרַ֨ע שָׁכַ֧ב כַּאֲרִ֛י וּכְלָבִ֖יא מִ֣י יְקִימֶ֑נּוּ מְבָרֲכֶ֣יךָ בָר֔וּךְ וְאֹרְרֶ֖יךָ אָרֽוּר׃
verses.transliteration: kā·ra‘ šā·ḵaḇ ka·’ă·rî ū·ḵə·lā·ḇî mî yə·qî·men·nū mə·ḇā·ră·ḵe·ḵā ḇā·rūḵ wə·’ō·rə·re·ḵā ’ā·rūr
verses.literal: He crouches he lies down like a lion like a lioness who dares to rouse him Blessed are those who bless you and cursed are those who curse you

verses.original: וַיִּֽחַר־ אַ֤ף בָּלָק֙ אֶל־ בִּלְעָ֔ם וַיִּסְפֹּ֖ק אֶת־ כַּפָּ֑יו וַיֹּ֨אמֶר בָּלָ֜ק אֶל־ בִּלְעָ֗ם לָקֹ֤ב אֹֽיְבַי֙ קְרָאתִ֔יךָ וְהִנֵּה֙ בֵּרַ֣כְתָּ בָרֵ֔ךְ זֶ֖ה שָׁלֹ֥שׁ פְּעָמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·ḥar- ’ap̄ bā·lāq ’el- bil·‘ām way·yis·pōq ’eṯ- kap·pāw way·yō·mer bā·lāq ’el- bil·‘ām lā·qōḇ ’ō·yə·ḇay qə·rā·ṯî·ḵā wə·hin·nêh bê·raḵ·tā ḇā·rêḵ zeh šā·lōš pə·‘ā·mîm
verses.literal: Then Balak’s anger burned against Balaam and he struck his hands together and said . . . to Balaam I summoned you to curse my enemies but behold you have persisted in blessing them . . . these three times

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֖ה בְּרַח־ לְךָ֣ אֶל־ מְקוֹמֶ֑ךָ אָמַ֙רְתִּי֙ כַּבֵּ֣ד אֲכַבֶּדְךָ֔ וְהִנֵּ֛ה מְנָעֲךָ֥ יְהוָ֖ה מִכָּבֽוֹד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh bə·raḥ- lə·ḵā ’el- mə·qō·w·me·ḵā ’ā·mar·tî kab·bêḏ ’ă·ḵab·beḏ·ḵā wə·hin·nêh mə·nā·‘ă·ḵā Yah·weh mik·kā·ḇō·wḏ
verses.literal: Therefore , flee at once to your home I said I would reward you richly . . . but instead the LORD has denied your reward

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר בִּלְעָ֖ם אֶל־ בָּלָ֑ק הֲלֹ֗א גַּ֧ם אֶל־ מַלְאָכֶ֛יךָ אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁלַ֥חְתָּ אֵלַ֖י דִּבַּ֥רְתִּי לֵאמֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer bil·‘ām ’el- bā·lāq hă·lō gam ’el- mal·’ā·ḵe·ḵā ’ă·šer- šā·laḥ·tā ’ê·lay dib·bar·tî lê·mōr
verses.literal: Balaam . . . answered Balak Did I not already . . . tell . . . the messengers you sent me . . .

verses.original: אִם־ יִתֶּן־ לִ֨י בָלָ֜ק מְלֹ֣א בֵיתוֹ֮ כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָב֒ לֹ֣א אוּכַ֗ל לַעֲבֹר֙ אֶת־ פִּ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת טוֹבָ֛ה א֥וֹ רָעָ֖ה מִלִּבִּ֑י אֲשֶׁר־ יְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֹת֥וֹ אֲדַבֵּֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’im- yit·ten- lî ḇā·lāq mə·lō ḇê·ṯōw ke·sep̄ wə·zā·hāḇ lō ’ū·ḵal la·‘ă·ḇōr ’eṯ- pî Yah·weh la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ṭō·w·ḇāh ’ōw rā·‘āh mil·lib·bî ’ă·šer- yə·ḏab·bêr Yah·weh ’ō·ṯōw ’ă·ḏab·bêr
verses.literal: that even if Balak were to give me his house full of silver and gold I could not do anything of my own accord good or bad to go beyond the command of the LORD I must speak whatever the LORD says

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה הִנְנִ֥י הוֹלֵ֖ךְ לְעַמִּ֑י לְכָה֙ אִיעָ֣צְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַעֲשֶׂ֜ה הָעָ֥ם הַזֶּ֛ה לְעַמְּךָ֖ בְּאַחֲרִ֥ית הַיָּמִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh hin·nî hō·w·lêḵ lə·‘am·mî lə·ḵāh ’î·‘ā·ṣə·ḵā ’ă·šer ya·‘ă·śeh hā·‘ām haz·zeh lə·‘am·mə·ḵā bə·’a·ḥă·rîṯ hay·yā·mîm
verses.literal: Now . . . I am going back to my people but come let me warn you what this people will do to your people in the days to come

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֥א מְשָׁל֖וֹ וַיֹּאמַ֑ר נְאֻ֤ם בִּלְעָם֙ בְּנ֣וֹ בְעֹ֔ר וּנְאֻ֥ם הַגֶּ֖בֶר שְׁתֻ֥ם הָעָֽיִן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·śā mə·šā·lōw way·yō·mar nə·’um bil·‘ām bə·nōw ḇə·‘ōr ū·nə·’um hag·ge·ḇer šə·ṯum hā·‘ā·yin
verses.literal: Then Balaam lifted up an oracle saying This is the prophecy of Balaam son of Beor the prophecy of a man whose eyes are open

verses.original: נְאֻ֗ם שֹׁמֵ֙עַ֙ אִמְרֵי־ אֵ֔ל וְיֹדֵ֖עַ דַּ֣עַת עֶלְי֑וֹן מַחֲזֵ֤ה שַׁדַּי֙ יֶֽחֱזֶ֔ה נֹפֵ֖ל וּגְל֥וּי עֵינָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: nə·’um šō·mê·a‘ ’im·rê- ’êl wə·yō·ḏê·a‘ da·‘aṯ ‘el·yō·wn ma·ḥă·zêh šad·day ye·ḥĕ·zeh nō·p̄êl ū·ḡə·lui ‘ê·nā·yim
verses.literal: the prophecy of one who hears the words of God who has knowledge . . . from the Most High who sees a vision from the Almighty who bows down with eyes wide open

verses.original: אֶרְאֶ֙נּוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א עַתָּ֔ה אֲשׁוּרֶ֖נּוּ וְלֹ֣א קָר֑וֹב דָּרַ֨ךְ כּוֹכָ֜ב מִֽיַּעֲקֹ֗ב וְקָ֥ם שֵׁ֙בֶט֙ מִיִּשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּמָחַץ֙ פַּאֲתֵ֣י מוֹאָ֔ב וְקַרְקַ֖ר כָּל־ בְּנֵי־ שֵׁ֔ת׃
verses.transliteration: ’er·’en·nū wə·lō ‘at·tāh ’ă·šū·ren·nū wə·lō qā·rō·wḇ dā·raḵ kō·w·ḵāḇ mî·ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·qām šê·ḇeṭ mî·yiś·rā·’êl ū·mā·ḥaṣ pa·’ă·ṯê mō·w·’āḇ wə·qar·qar kāl- bə·nê- šēṯ
verses.literal: I see him but not now I behold him but not near A star will come forth from Jacob and a scepter will arise from Israel He will crush the skulls of Moab and strike down all the sons of Sheth

verses.original: וְהָיָ֨ה אֱד֜וֹם יְרֵשָׁ֗ה וְהָיָ֧ה יְרֵשָׁ֛ה שֵׂעִ֖יר אֹיְבָ֑יו וְיִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עֹ֥שֶׂה חָֽיִל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ’ĕ·ḏō·wm yə·rê·šāh wə·hā·yāh yə·rê·šāh śê·‘îr ’ō·yə·ḇāw wə·yiś·rā·’êl ‘ō·śeh ḥā·yil
verses.literal: Edom will become a possession as will Seir his enemy but Israel will perform with valor

verses.original: וְיֵ֖רְדְּ מִֽיַּעֲקֹ֑ב וְהֶֽאֱבִ֥יד שָׂרִ֖יד מֵעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·yê·rəd mî·ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·he·’ĕ·ḇîḏ śā·rîḏ mê·‘îr
verses.literal: A ruler will come from Jacob and destroy the survivors of the city

verses.original: וַיַּרְא֙ אֶת־ עֲמָלֵ֔ק וַיִּשָּׂ֥א מְשָׁל֖וֹ וַיֹּאמַ֑ר רֵאשִׁ֤ית גּוֹיִם֙ עֲמָלֵ֔ק וְאַחֲרִית֖וֹ עֲדֵ֥י אֹבֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar ’eṯ- ‘ă·mā·lêq way·yiś·śā mə·šā·lōw way·yō·mar rê·šîṯ gō·w·yim ‘ă·mā·lêq wə·’a·ḥă·rî·ṯōw ‘ă·ḏê ’ō·ḇêḏ
verses.literal: Then Balaam saw Amalek and lifted up an oracle saying Amalek was first among the nations but his end . . . is destruction

verses.original: וַיַּרְא֙ אֶת־ הַקֵּינִ֔י וַיִּשָּׂ֥א מְשָׁל֖וֹ וַיֹּאמַ֑ר אֵיתָן֙ מֽוֹשָׁבֶ֔ךָ וְשִׂ֥ים בַּסֶּ֖לַע קִנֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yar ’eṯ- haq·qê·nî way·yiś·śā mə·šā·lōw way·yō·mar ’ê·ṯān mō·wō·šā·ḇe·ḵā wə·śîm bas·se·la‘ qin·ne·ḵā
verses.literal: Next he saw the Kenites and lifted up an oracle saying Your dwelling place is secure and your nest is set in a cliff

verses.original: כִּ֥י אִם־ יִהְיֶ֖ה לְבָ֣עֵֽר קָ֑יִן עַד־ מָ֖ה אַשּׁ֥וּר תִּשְׁבֶּֽךָּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- yih·yeh lə·ḇā·‘êr qā·yin ‘aḏ- māh ’aš·šūr tiš·be·kā
verses.literal: Yet . . . Kain will be destroyed when . . . Asshur takes you captive

verses.original: וַיִּשָּׂ֥א מְשָׁל֖וֹ וַיֹּאמַ֑ר א֕וֹי מִ֥י יִחְיֶ֖ה מִשֻּׂמ֥וֹ אֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiś·śā mə·šā·lōw way·yō·mar ’ō·w mî yiḥ·yeh miś·śu·mōw ’êl
verses.literal: Once more Balaam lifted up an oracle saying Ah who can live unless God has ordained it

verses.original: וְצִים֙ מִיַּ֣ד כִּתִּ֔ים וְעִנּ֥וּ אַשּׁ֖וּר וְעִנּוּ־ עֵ֑בֶר וְגַם־ ה֖וּא עֲדֵ֥י אֹבֵֽד׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ṣîm mî·yaḏ kit·tîm wə·‘in·nū ’aš·šūr wə·‘in·nū- ‘ê·ḇer wə·ḡam- hū ‘ă·ḏê ’ō·ḇêḏ
verses.literal: Ships will come from the coasts of Cyprus they will subdue Asshur . . . and Eber but they too will perish forever

verses.original: וַיָּ֣קָם בִּלְעָ֔ם וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ וַיָּ֣שָׁב לִמְקֹמ֑וֹ וְגַם־ בָּלָ֖ק הָלַ֥ךְ לְדַרְכּֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām bil·‘ām way·yê·leḵ way·yā·šāḇ lim·qō·mōw wə·ḡam- bā·lāq hā·laḵ lə·ḏar·kōw
verses.literal: Then Balaam arose and returned to his homeland and Balak also went on his way
